Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity AutoFlow desktop product screen, 1488 × 1056 pixels, matching the supplied selected resource-board prototype. The input is a STYLE AND APPLICATION SHELL REFERENCE, not content to reproduce. This is a complementary detailed page within the user's selected design, not a new competing concept. Chinese UI, crisp readable 14–16px body, no external annotation, no concept number. Preserve slim macOS title bar, AutoFlow logo and horizontal global nav 总览 / 自动化 / 浏览器配置 / 安卓模拟器 active / 代理管理 / 模型管理, quiet Mac 本机 · 已连接. Warm canvas #f1eee7, surface #fbfaf7, subtle #f6f3ee, line #d8d3c9, ink #34322e, muted #625e57, clay #8d4e2f and clay light #f2e3d7, sage #4f694a. Inter and PingFang SC. 8px control radii, 12px panel radii, restrained shallow shadow, simple line icons. Strong hierarchy with generous spacing and row separators; no nested cards, neon, gradients, extraneous metrics, perspective or presentation boards. One full straight-on app screenshot. Realistic example data, no time-sensitive dates. Keep the hero workflow focused.
Page name: 实例详情 · 手动控制.
Breadcrumb 返回资源看板 / 测试设备 01. Header 测试设备 01 with small green Android 已就绪 and tag 持久实例. Right actions 复制配置 and overflow menu. Tab strip 控制台 active / 应用 / 环境配置 / 运行记录.
Main area: a broad device stage on left occupying approximately 960px, and a right utility column about 390px. Top of stage has green indicator 手动控制中, helper 由你独占操作, and outlined button 结束控制 on right. Under this a single centered LARGE embedded Android screen about 340×590px, thin dark edge, NO physical device body or camera cutout. Display a simple Chinese Notes app: 笔记, title 回归测试, editable note with two lines 安装应用 and 检查登录页, small blinking caret and visible mouse pointer over the note. Comfortable plain pale warm stage margins. Vertical slim toolbar immediately right of Android image: 返回, 主页, 最近任务, 音量, 旋转, 截图; icons with tiny readable labels, no duplicate navigation bars outside. Above screen small 适应窗口 dropdown and 全屏 action. Under stage helpful text 点击即触控 · 按住拖动可滑动 · 长按可呼出菜单. A small status pill 实时画面 should describe a proposed target with no made-up FPS or latency numbers.
Right utility column: title 输入与操作. Subtle control 键盘输入 enabled, text 点击画面后接收键盘事件. Text input subsection 文本发送 with a 3-line text area showing 测试账号 and primary 发送到设备, helper 中文通过文本发送. Below divider 应用 with 当前应用 笔记, small 上传 APK and 启动应用 controls.
Below another divider 设备信息: Android 13, 720 × 1280, 数据 持久保存, Root shell 可用. Bottom small 工作流 section says 手动控制期间不可分配 with disabled 分配给工作流, helper 结束控制后恢复可分配. Avoid showing automatic cleanup as a consequence of ending manual control.
Footer strip connection quality label 已连接 and 最新操作：文本已发送 · 刚刚. This is a polished target prototype; no claim that video transport or Chinese input is already implemented. No simultaneous workflow editing in this frame.

环境配置: large dropdown selected Android 13 标准 · ARM64, beside text link 管理配置. Below compact metadata summary 软件渲染 · 720 × 1280 · shell root 可用. Root helper 应用级 root 需单独验证. 数据与启动: a radio pair 持久实例 selected with explanation 保留应用和数据，适合重复调试, and 临时实例 unselected with explanation 供工作流使用，按运行清理策略回收. Clearly checked 创建后启动 toggle. Under it hint 启动完成且 Android 就绪后才可操作.

Bottom fixed-ish action strip within page, secondary 取消 on left, count 将创建 3 台持久实例 and clay 创建并启动 on right. A small line 创建进度可在资源看板逐台查看. All fields properly labeled and aligned, no excessive empty screen or extraneous dashboard information. No video control elements in this screen. Show practical form interaction, selected radio state, focus border on name input, actual realistic controls.

Page name 工作流占用 · 接管设备. This companion detail page should share the exact information structure of an instance console but show WORKFLOW OWNERSHIP with a manual takeover request panel. No unrelated dashboard.
Breadcrumb 返回资源看板 / 订单回归 03. Header 订单回归 03, small green 已就绪, clay 工作流占用, muted 临时实例. Tabs 控制台 active / 应用 / 环境配置 / 运行记录. Under tabs a full-width restrained pale clay notice with lock icon 工作流正在操作设备，当前为只读预览.
Main columns: LEFT wide device stage about 950px, RIGHT workflow summary about 420px. Left stage top reads 只读预览 with lock, small 查看画面 dropdown and full-screen icon. Center large embedded Android screen about 320×565px showing a plain example app 订单列表, a search field, three generic order rows 待处理 / 已完成 / 已完成, no commerce brand or private information. Thin screen edge, no physical phone camera or elaborate device body. Adjacent manual toolbar icons 返回 / 主页 / 最近任务 visibly disabled gray. Under stage helper 取得控制权后才能点击、输入或安装应用. No confusing disabled screenshot: a separate available 截图 button can remain enabled for observation.
Right column header 当前工作流, owner 订单回归, run label 本次运行, state 运行中. Show compact progress 3 / 6 and a thin clay progress bar. A vertical three-item simple timeline: check 启动应用 · 已完成, active 验证订单列表 · 执行中, dot 保存截图 · 等待执行. Then thin divider, section 手动接管. Text 暂停成功后，设备才交给你操作. A pale notice 当前步骤结束后暂停. Primary clay button 暂停并接管. Secondary text 保持只读 below. Do NOT show paused success yet, do NOT show editable input enabled yet. Beneath modest note 接管期间保留实例，不执行自动清理. Then divider 完成后处理 with label 临时实例 · 自动清理, helper 手动接管时暂缓回收.
At bottom subtle footer states 画面连接正常 · 输入已锁定. The design's explicit action is REQUEST PAUSE AND TAKE OVER; it cannot imply immediate force takeover. This is a proposed future interaction, no claim already implemented. Make visual hierarchy strongly demonstrate device viewing without interference. No modal overlay blocking the actual screen. No frame within frame or multiple alternatives in image.
